purpose: Convert E110 cascade model into falsifiable fieldwork predictions

gpr_targeted.scenario: 20 GPR surveys at E080 high-suitability targets

random_cores.falsification: 0 finds in 50 cores would be concerning but not decisive (P=30.3%)

construction_monitoring.scenario: Monitor 250 deep construction projects over 5 years
construction_monitoring.historical_rate: ~1 accidental find per 15 years in Central Java

verdict: The cascade model generates testable predictions. 20 targeted GPR surveys should find 0-6 anomalies (95% CI). Zero finds would reject the framework (P=0.070). Japan-level survey intensity would increase detectable pre-Hindu sites from ~6 to ~112.
